movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Twister
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Play Nice
movelist.effect: Play Nice lowers the target’s Attack by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Echoed Voice
movelist.effect: If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainer in the Encounter on the previous round, increase its Damage Base by +4. If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainers during both the previous two rounds, increase its Damage Base by +8.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Special Attack Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Grass-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Grass-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.
